column1: # Reviewed reference entries for game code that is not matched (owner rule, 21 Oct 2026; docs/progress.md).
# An entry counts only when a second reader has checked its name and purpose against the disassembly; the
# reviewer note records that check. Exactly one status per range: entries may not overlap, and
# tools/census_classify.py stops the score refresh on a malformed row, an unknown status or an overlap.
# Statuses: stays-original, machine-option-only, dead-certified, probable-dead, needs-route, data, unreached-held.
#   stays-original  its executed bytes enter the gameplay score's numerator, only for a routine that stays original
#                   by design rule: inside the census every byte must lie in a docs/census-original.tsv row; outside
#                   the census `why not matched` must start with the rule (STI-first handler, C start-up, palette
#                   loader with STI, program launcher, hardware wait loop, packer stub). A declined routine (VGAME main, MPS_LOGO 1ADC/1C82, START 8427, END 4393,
#                   END 57B0, ...) is remaining work and cannot be listed as stays-original.
#   any status      a byte of the previous all-code scope that no route executes is "accounted for" in the checklist.
# Columns (tab-separated): module, linear start (hex), bytes (decimal), name, purpose, status, why not matched,

column5: IRQ 0 handler (INT 8, set by INT 21h AX=2508h from the far pointer at 0000:4BEB): STI, saves the registers, loads DS=05FAh, adds the rate word [50D4h] into the 32-bit tick sum [50CEh]; every [50D8h] ticks (countdown [50E2h]) calls 4C55h and 4D51h and clears [50CAh]; far-calls 05FA:2602 unless [50D8h]=1; then EOI and IRET while the sum's high word is zero, otherwise decrements it and chains (CLI, patched far jump at 4C50h) to the saved INT 8
column7: STI-first handler: STI is its first instruction (census-original reason: after STI the run loop admits one more instruction, so a body cannot do more than the original); its chaining far jump is a 0000:0000 placeholder patched at run time
